headline: Chairman's Group Increases Stake, Xay Dung 47 Pushes Hydropower in Laos
summary: A shareholder group linked to Board Chairman Pham Nam Phong is increasing its holding in Xay Dung 47, approaching the 35% capital threshold, while the company pushes its energy development strategy in Laos.
why: Changes in major shareholdings near ownership thresholds can affect control and governance, and hydropower projects drive the company's earnings.
